selection:
EXP-09 frozen failing-log corpus builder (ws58, 2026-11-02). Deterministic: expanded R3 corpus; deterministic sorted candidate scan.

Selection: real pytest logs already on disk under /mnt/raid0/llm/tmp (prior CI/test runs), each
  * UTF-8 text, 9,000..120,000 chars (above the 8,192-char spill threshold, so _spill_output really spills),
  * a pytest terminal summary line with >=1 failed, and >=1 `FAILED <nodeid>` line,
  * no credential-like content, unique content sha, at most one log per top-level scratch dir (diversity).
Gold facts are extracted deterministically from the FULL log (never from any arm's view).
Copies go to corpus/item-NN.log (chmod a-w); manifest corpus/MANIFEST.json carries source path, sha256, gold.

provenance.selection_method: Same constraints and gold_of as R2 builder: sorted find under tmp, maxdepth 6, *.log/*.txt, file-size filter +9k/-150k; UTF-8, 9000..120000 chars, no NUL or listed credential patterns, pytest summary with >=1 failed and FAILED nodeid; content SHA unique; one source per top-level group. Excluded existing source groups, matching content hashes, and every path containing brf-exp09. Copied only selected log files, never source trees.

extended_scan.selection: Exact build_corpus.py gold_of and credential regex; UTF-8; pytest failure summary plus FAILED node; no NUL; 9,000..120,000 decoded chars in original stratum, or 8,193..512,000 chars in explicit expanded stratum. Excluded candidates exceeding 512,000 bytes/chars: gold-slice matplotlib-14623 (523,905 B) and swe-eval-A1 scikit-learn-11310 (531,838 B). Only individual log files were copied; no inference-generated brf-exp09 paths were included.
extended_scan.gzip_handling: One existing compressed historical evidence log was included after gzip decompression. Each entry stores source_file_sha256/source_file_bytes for original source bytes and sha256/chars for decompressed local custody bytes.
extended_scan.grouping: Source group is the originating top-level tmp source for items 13–14; for research additions it is the named run_evaluation campaign; for evidence/control files it is the named evidence/control run. Repeated groups mean correlated cases, not independent samples. The 12 added cases occupy 9 groups: two tmp sources, five research campaigns, one evidence campaign, one p5 control campaign. The research campaign gold-smoke has 3 cases and swe-eval-A1 has 2. q38 and swe-eval-A1 both include SWE issue scikit-learn-10908, but their first failed test nodes differ.
extended_scan.coverage: An independent scout screened /mnt/raid0/llm/epyc-inference-research and the root worktree; this session additionally screened worktrees, workspace artifacts/evidence/progress, tmp-bench, logs, research export, archives/autokernel, and kernels/builds. Candidate scout reported 35 qualifying research logs, ten representative distinct first-failure test IDs, and two root-control logs; gzip was separately checked and one root evidence gzip qualified.
